acceptance_rows: Derive the required scenario set from the authoritative harness registry for the current source tree, including newly registered scenarios; never trust the submitted summary to define required coverage.

Require results to contain every registered scenario exactly once, no unknown scenario IDs, and literal boolean true pass values; reject malformed records, missing scenarios, duplicate IDs, false values, and truthy nonboolean values.
Preserve current source-hash validation and reject selective-run summaries at the handoff gate even when all included results pass and source hashes match.

Add fresh scenario O71 exercising complete valid evidence and rejection of selective, missing, duplicate, unknown, malformed, false, nonboolean, and stale-source evidence through the actual summary checker.
Keep selective harness execution available for card validation; only complete suite evidence may satisfy the handoff coverage requirement.
objective: Require complete, unique, strictly passing scenario coverage before accepting E2E handoff evidence.
stop_condition: Print CARD_BLOCKED C10: <reason> and stop if an authoritative scenario registry cannot be consumed safely within the allowed files, or any instruction conflicts. Use only read/edit/write tools, create no other files, keep each edit below 3000 characters, and finish with exactly CARD_DONE C10.
